description:
The "Moment" Balance Board (Patent Pending )

Are you Ready for Your Moment?

Strong and shaped intelligently: Made from strong and durable Canadian Maple wood, the Moment Balance Board can hold users up to 300 lbs. Measuring 30” x 12” x ½”, it offers the right amount of surface area for use with a variety of standing orientations.

Adjustable 'Center Rail', creating a balanced edge on your competition: The Moment Balance Board features patent-pending HDPE molded plastic ‘end rails’ with a “no tools” adjustable ‘center rail’.  Athletes can use the center rail setting for a traditional balance board experience or move the rail to the forward setting to facilitate an advanced “forward stance” approach while on the board. This setting will help create the awareness of the proper body positioning that is needed to advance one’s alpine skiing.

Wooden roller with center channel: At the center of our Balance board system is the wooden roller with center channel. This allows for lateral tracking of the board and facilitates fore aft rolling, while minimizing chances of a board ‘spinout’. With a diameter of 3.75” and length of 9.25”, its optimal dimensions were engineered for advanced balance board users like yourself.

A home for your balance board training: The 3’x2’ yoga style rubber mat is now your Balance board training area. Increasing grip between the roller and the floor, it increased feel and provides added safety during use.

Traction for your feet: The Moment Balance Board comes with a stylish grip tape ‘landscape’ design or classic logo that provides the necessary traction for your feet on the board. It ensures stability and balance, even during the most challenging workouts.

Warranty: The Moment Balance Board comes with a 1-year unlimited warranty, ensuring customer satisfaction and peace of mind.

Enhance your balance and core strength with the Moment Balance Board.  Your Moment Awaits!
